descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-18 Billing Suggestion · S20 「现成的 spec：计费调用失败时显示带重试的报错，重试会存下建议」 Existing spec: a failed billing call shows an error with retry, and the retry saves the suggestion

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U15 If the billing call fails, the call is retried automatically, the note is still shown and the billing area shows a clear error with a way to retry; …（UAT Empty & Failure States (Billing suggestion failed)；UAT 3.5；TFA-94745 AC 4）

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Hospital patient with a generated SOAP note; the first billing call is made to fail at the Convex socket

When Open Post-Round, tap the retry control

Then The billing area shows 'Couldn’t generate billing suggestion — tap to retry'; the retry shows and saves the suggestion for that note

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright assertions in billing-suggestion.spec.ts (retry visible, two calls, saved billingForNoteAt). Not asserted by this spec: the note staying visible and the automatic retry before the error (TFA-94745 AC 4) - both are in the Empty & Failure States matrix

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 FAULT · 故障注入；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S20 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-18.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：FAULT · 故障注入；辅助：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。
